subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scoping & audit evidence (Acme Health)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: John Doe <j.doe@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:03:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap: SOC 2 scoping & audit evidence (Acme Health)

Thanks again for the time today \u0014 appreciate the clear overview of Acme Health's compliance requirements. Below is a concise recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum with procurement and security.

Key pain points and goals (what I heard):
- You need SOC 2 Type II evidence for vendor approval and an auditable trail of access and admin activity.
- Retention/forensics: 2 years of immutable audit logs, with export capability for your auditors.
- Data residency & isolation: ability to scope data handling to a dedicated project or VPC for PHI-sensitive workflows.
- DPA & contractual terms: standard redlines around data subject rights, retention, and breach notification timelines.
- Pen test & vulnerability evidence: summary report and remediation notes.

Technical constraints / preferences:
- Preferred timeline: security review complete by 2026-03-25 to align with your vendor board.
- Eval environment: request for a short PoC with sample production-like telemetry but with masked data.
- KMS: you use Azure Key Vault; need details on Redwood's KMS/HSM integrations and key lifecycle.

What Redwood will provide (next deliverables):
1) Pack of compliance artifacts: SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted), penetration test summary, sample audit logs, and our DPA draft.
   - Attached: SOC2-request-checklist.pdf (checklist we use to map your asks to artifacts).
2) Short technical deep-dive (30-45m) with our security architect to review log formats, retention window, and KMS integration.
3) Proposed mutual action plan and timeline aligned to your vendor approval date.

Proposed next steps / dates:
- I will send the compliance pack by EOD Thursday (2026-02-26).
- Can we schedule the technical deep-dive the week of 2026-03-02? Suggested slots: Tue 03/03 10:00-11:00 or Wed 03/04 14:00-15:00 PT.
- Please loop procurement contact and your SOC owner (if not already copied).

If I've missed anything or mis-prioritized items, tell me and I'll adjust the pack.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: SOC2-request-checklist.pdf (stub)

Thanks, Neha \u0014 solid recap. A few clarifying items from our side: 

- Confirming we need SOC 2 Type II within the last 12 months (redacted copy ok).
- For audit logs: we need events for admin console actions, API access with full timestamps, and user-level activity for 24 months. Export should be CSV/NDJSON and include retention metadata.
- Pen test: a high-level exec summary + listing of CVEs addressed; we don't need raw vuln scans.
- DPA: our legal team will want to review redlines; procurement included on this thread (please include an editable Docx).

One question: does Redwood offer a \"dedicated\" deployment or VPC option that would help with our isolation requirements? If so, pricing and typical lead time would be helpful.

Also \u0014 John on our side will be primary security contact: John Doe (j.doe@acmehealth.com). I've cc'd Alice from engineering for the PoC scheduling.
